about: Human whole-blood clot (in vitro), calibrated by the plugin's pure-shear replication on the raw data of Lohr, Bechtel, Dortdivanlioglu and Rausch (2025, Int. J. Fract., doi:10.1007/s10704-024-00820-4; data doi:10.18738/T8/97ZAZN and doi:10.18738/T8/DUJWSR, CC0 1.0): a Yeoh law fitted to the unnotched mean through the phase-field run, the AT2 toughness from notch group 4's peak force. The three constants are a set, to use together with this model at l = 0.25 mm. Every value is labelled by its source; a value marked placeholder is not a measurement.

labels.yeoh_c1: fitted (+-18 Pa, jackknife over samples): Gauss-Newton through the plugin's unnotched phase-field run (incompressible plane stress, l 0.25 mm) to the mean of the three unnotched raw curves at stretch 1.025-1.50; C1 = mu / 2
labels.yeoh_c2: fitted (+-95 Pa, jackknife): the same fit; C1 and C2 trade off against each other and against Gc
labels.poisson_ratio: placeholder: the fit was incompressible; a compressible 3-D or axisymmetric build needs a bulk modulus, and 0.45 (kappa about 9.7 mu) is chosen for the solver's conditioning, not measured
labels.young_modulus: derived: 2 mu (1 + nu) with mu = 2 C1 and the placeholder nu
labels.toughness: calibrated (+-0.17 J/m^2, jackknife): the AT2 Gc at which the model's peak force meets notch group 4's raw mean (69.76 mN); at l 0.25 mm, in incompressible plane stress
labels.length_scale: chosen, not fitted: the replication's AT2 length scale (Gc and the Yeoh constants are tied to it)
labels.stretch_limit: placeholder (read only by the element-deletion control)
labels.residual_stiffness: numerical: the fully damaged material's share of stiffness

validity: pure shear to stretch about 1.5 (fit) and 1.55 (failure), at a grip rate of 0.2 mm/s; not validated in compression, at other rates or in other clots; puncture with these constants is a prediction (Yeoh beyond stretch 1.5, isotropy, damage driven by the whole energy in compression too). The replication's model had no tension-compression split; the plugin's axisymmetric and 3-D blocks have one.
claim: At Gc*, the model gives held-out group 5's peak force within 2 % (inside its band) and groups 1-3's 19 to 24 % low, for in-vitro whole-blood clot in pure shear at 0.2 mm/s. It does not reproduce the notch dependence with one Gc.
model: Yeoh (C1, C2) with a compressible bulk term and an AT2 phase field; the clot's viscoelasticity, fluid and heterogeneity are not in it
